role_voices.text_en: Doma appreciates my talents and visits me often. However... every time she comes, she ends up bickering with Seimei. It's such a headache.

role_voices.text_zh: 魔王大人，下個月我和哈梅爾要上台合奏喔！有興趣來聽聽嗎？
role_voices.text_en: Lord Archfiend, Hamel and I are performing a duet on stage next month! Would be interested in coming to listen?

role_voices.text_zh: 你問我有沒有和藤原佐為下過圍棋嗎？嗯嗯……唔嗯嗯——！藤原佐為是誰啊？
role_voices.text_en: Have I ever played Go with Fujiwara no Sai? Hmm... uh—who's Fujiwara no Sai again?

role_voices.text_zh: 多虧魔王大人的幫助，才讓我在陰陽五行之術的學習中更上一層樓。今天……也能幫我對吧？♥
role_voices.text_en: Thanks to your help, Lord Archfiend, I've managed to reach a new level in my study of Onmyodo. You'll... help me again today, won't you? ♥

role_voices.text_zh: 魔王大人……姆啾——姆嗯嗯……姆哈！和魔王大人的接吻真是讓人上癮♥
role_voices.text_en: Lord Archfiend... mwah—mmw... ah! Kissing you is so addictive~♥

role_voices.text_zh: 答啷啷～答、答啷啷～答！……噹噹！

role_voices.text_en: Ding dong ding~~ Dong dong dong ding!
Although they are flowers I am used to seeing every day...

role_voices.text_zh: 然而多虧白露的點綴，方有今日不凡的光輝！
role_voices.text_en: Yet it is thanks to the touch of white dew that today's extraordinary radiance is possible!

role_voices.text_zh: 即便我倒了……我的雅樂……也不會消失……！
role_voices.text_en: Even if I fall... my Gagaku will never disappear...!

role_voices.text_zh: 呼！結束啦。要不要來一場雅樂慶祝一下呢？
role_voices.text_en: Phew! It's over. Shall we have a Gagaku performance to celebrate?
